note: Both sets correctly capture the 2'-9 1/2" finished floor over 0'-0" grade and the room contents of the two sections, but both also invent a 2'-3 1/2" finished floor value that appears nowhere on the sheet. Set A additionally binds the 3/8"=1'-0" scales to the correct detail bubbles (A1 Living Room Section, C1 Section – Centre Module) and records the Centre/West Module adjacency and Living Room–Kitchen layout, all supported by the drawing. Set B instead adds misbound or vague claims (CENTRE MODULE location = grid bubble K, Mechanical Room location = "Building Section A302", "building section contains room" with unnamed entity, WEST MODULE location = West) that the sheet does not support as stated. Set A is therefore more faithful overall despite its duplicate claims.
